about.title: Dublin Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision is a kind of grief that doesn't wait for paperwork or deadlines, yet California law gives surviving families a limited window to act. Dublin's 2025 public-record data shows 2 traffic deaths alongside 153 injury collisions along corridors like Dublin Boulevard, Dougherty Road, Amador Valley Boulevard, and Tassajara Road, with reported crashes clustering on Tuesday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. Under California law, standing to bring a wrongful death claim generally belongs first to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children, and then to certain other dependents or heirs if none exist. Families typically have two years from the date of death to file, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. LawProactive doesn't practice law itself; we simply connect grieving families in Dublin with an independent attorney who can walk through what the claim covers and what comes next.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, generally to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, then other dependents or heirs. An attorney can clarify where your family fits before any deadline passes.

items.title: Tracking the Two-Year Clock
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims involving a government entity often require notice far sooner. Connecting early helps preserve your family's options.

items.title: No Cost Unless There's a Recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in the LawProactive network work on contingency, meaning your family pays nothing upfront while sorting through funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's companionship.

items.question: What can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: California law allows families to seek compensation for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. It's a civil action separate from any criminal charges that might arise from the same crash. An attorney can explain how these categories might apply to your family's situation.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim different from a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: Yes. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil case brought by the family seeking compensation for their losses. The two can proceed on separate timelines and don't depend on each other's outcome.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a busy Dublin street like Dublin Boulevard or Dougherty Road?
items.answer: Public crash records show these corridors, along with Amador Valley Boulevard and Tassajara Road, among Dublin's higher collision-count roads, with many reported crashes occurring on Tuesday evenings. That context can be useful background, but every claim depends on its own specific facts, which an independent attorney can review with your family.
